Summarize a group transition process

Source: R/group_transition.R
summary.hammel_group_transition.Rd

Summary method for class "hammel_group_transition"

Usage

# S3 method for class 'hammel_group_transition'
summary(object, categories = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.hammel_group_transition'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

object

A hammel_group_transition object returned by group_transition().

categories

Optional character vector of the dimension's categories, used to count possible transitions. NULL (default) uses the categories that appear in the origin or destination columns.

...

Additional arguments, currently unused.

x

A summary.hammel_group_transition object returned by summary.hammel_group_transition().

Value

summary() returns an object of class summary.hammel_group_transition containing:

group

The name of the group dimension whose categories change, or NULL when the process applies to the model's only dimension.

categories

The categories used to define possible transitions.

transitions

A tibble of the origin and destination pairs that have a positive rate in at least one band or stratum.

missing_transitions

A tibble of the possible origin and destination pairs between distinct categories that have no positive rate in any band or stratum.

rate_strata

A list describing the transition rate schedule apart from its origin and destination columns, containing stratified_by (stratum column names), strata (a tibble of observed stratum combinations), bands (a tibble of exact band combinations), and bands_by_stratum (whether band combinations differ by stratum). Shared bands are stored once; otherwise bands includes the stratum columns. Band endpoints define half-open intervals [start, end).

weights

A summary of the weight model used for selection within rate cells: a summary.hammel_weight_model, a list of periods and models for a calendar schedule, or NULL when selection is unweighted.

age_independence

The household age of independence, in years, or NULL when transitions move individuals rather than households.

See also

group_transition(), household()

Examples

rates <- tibble::tribble(
  ~age_start, ~age_end, ~origin, ~destination, ~rate,
  0,          Inf,      "A",     "B",          0.05,
  0,          Inf,      "B",     "A",          0.02
)
process <- group_transition(rates, household = household())
summary(process)
#> 
#> ── Group transition process ──
#> 
#> • Group dimension: the model's only dimension
#> • Transitions (2 of 2 possible): A → B, B → A
#> • Missing transitions: none
#> • Stratified by: none
#> • Age bands (years): [0, Inf)
#> • Household moves: yes, age of independence 18 years
#> • Weight model: none
